title: energy-platform — prices and load (Silver current views)

panels.title: OTE continuous intraday — price_vwap per delivery period (T1 SOAP is the system of record; T2 XLSX is the copy)
panels.description: One line per transport from observations_current_by_transport (ADR-023 amendment 1): where the two lines diverge the platform raised a reconciliation_mismatch event.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT lower(delivery_interval) AS "time", source_transport AS metric, value::float8 AS value
FROM observations_current_by_transport
WHERE dataset_id = 'ote.idm_continuous' AND metric = 'price_vwap'
  AND $__timeFilter(lower(delivery_interval))
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: OTE continuous intraday — traded volume per period (MWh, canonical row)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT lower(delivery_interval) AS "time", 'volume_total' AS metric, value::float8 AS value
FROM observations_current
WHERE dataset_id = 'ote.idm_continuous' AND metric = 'volume_total'
  AND $__timeFilter(lower(delivery_interval))
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: OTE day-ahead — price per delivery period (EUR/MWh)
panels.description: Published once a day for the next day (ADR-033 amendment 3); the line runs ahead of now.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT lower(delivery_interval) AS "time", resolution AS metric, value::float8 AS value
FROM observations_current
WHERE dataset_id = 'ote.dam' AND metric = 'price'
  AND lower(delivery_interval) >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
  AND lower(delivery_interval) < $__timeTo()::timestamptz + interval '2 days'
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: ČEPS system load (MW, quarter-hour, real time)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT lower(delivery_interval) AS "time", 'load' AS metric, value::float8 AS value
FROM observations_current
WHERE dataset_id = 'ceps.load' AND metric = 'load' AND resolution = 'PT15M'
  AND $__timeFilter(lower(delivery_interval))
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: OTE imbalance settlement — prices (CZK/MWh) and system imbalance (MWh), by settlement version
panels.description: source_version 0 = daily, 1 = monthly, 2 = final; a later version supersedes the earlier one for the same period.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT lower(delivery_interval) AS "time", metric || ' v' || coalesce(source_version, '?') AS metric, value::float8 AS value
FROM observations_current
WHERE dataset_id = 'ote.imbalance_settlement'
  AND metric IN ('imbalance_price', 'counter_imbalance_price', 'system_imbalance')
  AND $__timeFilter(lower(delivery_interval))
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Newest current row per dataset and transport (what the platform holds right now)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT dataset_id, source_transport, count(*) AS current_rows,
       max(lower(delivery_interval)) AS newest_delivery_start,
       max(fetched_at) AS newest_fetch
FROM observations_current_by_transport
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
